newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Vietnamese prime minister to visit Globus.
newsitem.headline: Vietnamese prime minister to visit Globus.

text.p: Vietnamese Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet will visit Hungarian canned food manufacturer Globus Konzervipari Rt on Wednesday as part of a two-day official visit to Hungary which began on Tuesday.
"The Prime Minister and his ministers would like to see a food industrial plant," Globus' CEO Miklos Olah told Reuters.
Olah said he did not expect to talk about concrete deals with the prime minister, but he said Vietnam was a potential market for the company.
"There is potential for business as there are many kinds of raw materials that could be bought from Vietnam," he said, adding that Globus did not as yet have commercial ties with Vietnam.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Globus closed at 1,670 forints, down 30.
